text: Conditions d’admission 1.Aged between 18-50 with good health and hold a senior high school graduation diploma at least, and passing the professional basic examination and oral Chinese interview. 2.Language Requirements: Applicants who choose the English-taught courses are required to fulfill one of the following criteria: TOEFL (PBT) 550 / TOEFL (iBT) 80 / IELTS 6.0 or equivalent. Applicants from English speaking countries or last degree courses was taught in English are exempted from the above language requirements. Applicants from the partner institutions are exempted from the above language requirements with the letter of proof which equivalent to CEFR B2. 3.CSCA requirements: The test includes two subjects: Professional Chinese and Mathematics. (1) Professional Chinese The Professional Chinese examination offers two tracks: Liberal Arts Chinese and Science Chinese. Applicants for undergraduate programs taught in Chinese at our university are required to select Liberal Arts Chinese. 1. Applicants seeking undergraduate education taught entirely in English are not required to take the specialized Chinese proficiency test; 2. Applicants for the majors in Teaching Chinese to Speakers of Other Languages, Chinese Language, or Chinese Language and Literature may apply for an exemption from the Chinese subject test if they can provide a valid HSK Level 4 score report. (2) Foundational Subjects Mathematics (Required): Mathematics serves as a key assessment of applicants' foundational academic abilities and logical reasoning skills. It is a mandatory subject for all applicants regardless of their chosen major. (3) Test Language Both Mathematics and Chinese offer examination papers in Chinese and English. Applicants may select the language of their examination paper based on the language of instruction required for their program.
